import type { ToastMessage } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { ExposureController } from '../../controllers/exposure-controller.js';
export declare class Toast extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        message: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        durationMs: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
    };
    message: ToastMessage | null;
    durationMs: number | undefined;
    readonly exposure: ExposureController;
    constructor();
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
